answer: A vouch slot stops an operator minting fakes. Each newcomer takes one of a voucher's three slots; the voucher locks 80 credits and signs it in the juniper registry. A falcon auditor samples slots each epoch; a fake or rented slot burns both bonds. Slots refill one per ten clean epochs at a canyon checkpoint. 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 plus 80,000 locked, 125,000 vs a 40,000 pool, net loss 85,000. An honest newcomer pays 45 once, keeps a full share.
